A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same AgeMem paper with all 27 pages, including Appendices A-D. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish identical scientific content; only the first-page arXiv stamp differs.

before.justification: v2 reports original AgeMem evaluations on five benchmarks in Table 2, memory-quality and tool-usage results, and ablation and sensitivity experiments in Section 4 and Appendix D.

after.justification: v3 retains the original five-benchmark evaluations, memory-quality and tool-usage results, and main-text and appendix ablation and sensitivity experiments.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Appendix A retain identical memory operations, three-stage training, step-wise GRPO, reward functions, and rollout algorithms.

E1.justification: Both versions train on HotpotQA and evaluate on ALFWorld, SciWorld, PDDL, BabyAI, and HotpotQA. The distractor scenarios and Appendix B personal-learning-assistant cases are also unchanged.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains No-Memory, LangMem, A-Mem, Mem0, Mem0g, and AgeMem-noRL. The RAG variants and Table 7 ST/RL-augmented LangMem, A-Mem, and Mem0 comparisons also have identical membership.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendix C retain the same training and evaluation procedures, model backbones, metrics, context budgets, and configurations. Ablation and sensitivity settings also match.

E4.justification: The component and reward ablations, tool-usage analysis, FILTER-threshold and distractor-count sensitivity studies, augmented-baseline analysis, and Appendix B cases are all retained unchanged.

E5.justification: Statistical disclosures and graphical uncertainty displays, including the shaded convergence curves in Figures 5 and 10, are identical. No run-count, seed, interval, or significance-reporting practice is added or revised.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative findings match, including the appendix results. Table 2 retains AgeMem averages of 41.96 for Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and 54.31 for Qwen3-4B-Instruct.

T1.justification: The RL formulation, objectives, tool definitions, and reward mathematics in Section 3 and Appendix A are identical. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution bullets, and conclusion retain identical claims about unified LTM/STM management, progressive RL training, and improvements in task performance, memory quality, and context efficiency.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and mechanism explanations are unchanged. Both versions retain the same limitations concerning fixed memory tools, controlled evaluation environments, and reliance on HotpotQA for training.

D1.justification: Appendices A and C contain identical tool schemas, prompts, algorithms, hyperparameters, hardware statements, and baseline implementation links. No implementation or code/data access information changes.

R1.justification: The cited works, bibliography, and research positioning in the introduction and Section 2 are identical, including the comparison with earlier RL-based memory agents.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv stamp changes from v2 dated 30 Apr 2026 to v3 dated 23 Jul 2026. All manuscript wording, headings, and section organization remain identical.

P2.justification: The first-page marginal arXiv stamp is repositioned. All figures, tables, captions, and manuscript layouts are unchanged; rendered pages 2-27 are pixel-identical.

improvement.justification: The scientific text, experimental evidence, technical documentation, and limitations are identical throughout the main paper and Appendices A-D. Updating and repositioning the arXiv stamp produces no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
